add_copyright_header_to_python_file: run header.py with a .py filename to prepend a Facebook copyright header comment
add_copyright_header_to_c_file: run header.py with a .c .cc .h or .cpp filename to prepend a Facebook copyright header comment
prefixed_header_function: call prefixed_header with a comment prefix string to get a list of header lines with that prefix
review_prefixed_header_function: review the prefixed_header function that splits the copyright header text and prepends a given prefix to each line
summarize_header_script: summarize the header.py script that reads a source file and prepends a Facebook copyright header based on file extension
